tasks.label: Run Portfolio Web
args: $port = 5500; if (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process -FilePath 'py' -ArgumentList '-m http.server 5500' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Hidden; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50; $i++) { if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 } }; Start-Process 'http://localhost:5500/'
